title: Outdoor kitchens and canopies for private homes in Georgia
phrase: An outdoor kitchen can become a comfortable place for cooking, guests and everyday life in the yard.
text: We build outdoor kitchens with canopies, worktops, lighting, sinks, tile, microcement and careful metal structures. We first assess the site, dimensions, base and utilities, then propose a solution for the specific yard.
caseTitle: Outdoor kitchen with a large canopy
caseText: A real project with a large canopy, work zone, tile, metal structure, lighting and a dining table.
faq: Can you build only a canopy?
Yes. We first clarify whether it will later include a kitchen, table, barbecue, lighting or storage.
The material is selected according to the base, moisture, sun and use of the surface.
How much does an outdoor kitchen cost?
The exact cost depends on the base, canopy, metal, utilities, finishes and access to the site.
formText: Send photos, approximate dimensions and a short description of the kitchen or canopy you want.
